differences.title: 1. ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: TiDB separates compute (TiDB) and storage (TiKV), allowing independent scaling. TiKV uses RocksDB for distributed KV storage.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase integrates compute and storage within its nodes, optimizing data locality and reducing cross-node communication for transactions.

differences.title: 2. CONSISTENCY MODEL
differences.leftDesc: TiDB provides strong consistency for transactions, ensuring all replicas are updated before a commit is acknowledged, simplifying development.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase offers tunable consistency levels, from strong to eventual, allowing trade-offs between performance and data staleness for specific reads.

differences.title: 3. SQL COMPATIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: TiDB aims for high MySQL compatibility, making migration easier for MySQL users. It translates SQL to TiKV's KV operations.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase supports both MySQL and Oracle SQL dialects, providing flexibility for enterprises migrating from either system.

differences.title: 4. DISTRIBUTED TRANSACTIONS
differences.leftDesc: TiDB uses a distributed transaction protocol inspired by Google's Percolator, leveraging optimistic concurrency control for high throughput.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase employs a distributed Two-Phase Commit (2PC) protocol, ensuring atomicity across multiple nodes for ACID compliance.

differences.title: 5. STORAGE ENGINE
differences.leftDesc: TiKV is a distributed transactional key-value store built on RocksDB, offering strong consistency and high availability.
differences.rightDesc: OBStore is OceanBase's proprietary distributed storage engine, designed for high performance and fault tolerance with built-in data replication.

differences.title: 6. SCALABILITY
differences.leftDesc: TiDB allows independent scaling of compute (TiDB servers) and storage (TiKV nodes) based on workload demands.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase scales compute and storage together, simplifying management while offering horizontal scalability through its distributed nature.

differences.title: 7. REPLICATION STRATEGY
differences.leftDesc: TiKV utilizes the Raft consensus algorithm for data replication and fault tolerance across TiKV nodes.
differences.rightDesc: OceanBase uses a Raft-based distributed consensus algorithm for its internal data replication and consistency maintenance.
